Full payment for your Pre Order is taken up front at the point of your order being placed.

Require assistance? Contact our International Sales Team via international@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk and an advisor will be pleased to assist you.
This will be dealt with on a case-by-case basis. You will be informed on the delivery times for each item before we request payment.
We accept a wide variety of payment methods. For enquiries about specific payment methods, please contact us via international@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk

We physically stocks 1000’s of products in our England based
warehouse, all ready to be shipped immediately. If a product is available to Pre Order, this means that it’s on its way to our warehouse ready to ship as soon as it lands.
International delivery costs vary, for a bespoke quote, please contact our International Sales Team via international@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk

Yes, we ship anywhere, but offer our renowned in-house Dedicated Delivery service to Mainland UK, Northern Ireland, Ireland, France, Germany, and the Netherlands. Our team is working tirelessly on increasing the number of locations we ship to. Follow our social @williamwood for all announcements.

If you are interested in placing an order outside of the regions covered by Dedicated Delivery, please contact our International Sales Team via international@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk
Please update us of any address changes as soon as possible. Contact our International Sales Team via international@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk and an advisor will be pleased to assist you.
